steps.en: Install it (script, Homebrew, Scoop or the platform zip)
steps.zh: 安装（脚本、Homebrew、Scoop 或平台 zip）

steps.en: Scaffold a project and declare the output type in the source
steps.zh: 生成项目骨架，并在源文件里声明输出类型

steps.en: Parses the Markdown plus function calls and expands the standard library into its document model
steps.zh: 解析 Markdown 与函数调用，把标准库展开进自己的文档模型

steps.en: Compile the root file, adding live preview if you want it
steps.zh: 编译根文件，需要的话加上实时预览

steps.en: Renders that type to HTML, copying only the libraries it needs into the output's lib directory
steps.zh: 按该类型渲染成 HTML，只把需要的库拷进产物的 lib 目录

steps.en: With PDF output asked for, prints that same HTML through headless Chromium
steps.zh: 要求 PDF 时，把同一份 HTML 交给无头 Chromium 打印

value.en: One .qd source yields a web page, a print PDF and slides — the content never forks
value.zh: 一份 .qd 源产出网页、印刷 PDF 与幻灯片——内容不必分叉

sources: README.md About / Targets / Getting started (.doctype {plain|paged|slides|docs}, quarkdown create [directory], quarkdown c file.qd, -p/--preview, -w/--watch, --pdf, quarkdown repl)
skills/quarkdown/SKILL.md (bundled agent skill: quarkdown c <main>.qd --strict --out /tmp/quarkdown-verify; quarkdown doctor get install-dir)
docs/pdf-export.qd (--pdf needs a Chromium-family browser, defaults to chrome-headless-shell, --chrome-path, QD_CHROME_PATH)
docs/cli-compiler.qd (permission model: defaults + allowed - denied; --allow process)

quarkdown-html/src/main/kotlin/com/quarkdown/rendering/html/post/resources/ThirdPartyPostRendererResource.kt (bundles required third-party scripts, styles and fonts into the output lib/ directory, 'enabling fully offline HTML rendering')
quarkdown-html/package.json (pagedjs, reveal.js, katex, highlight.js, mermaid, minisearch, fontsource)
